name: Usy, Lapy i Khvost
source:
Whiskers, Paws, and a Tail - a story about the main Catgirl of the Camp. Be Gentle and Kind with her; don't hurt Yulya.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3843937403]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《胡须、肉垫与尾巴》——一个关于夏令营头号猫娘的故事。请温柔善待她，千万别伤害尤莉娅。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3843937403]Steam[/url]]
